newsitem.title: UK: Pearson sees 50 mln stg millennium bug hit.
newsitem.headline: Pearson sees 50 mln stg millennium bug hit.

text.p: British media and leisure company Pearson Plc may have to spend up to 50 million stg curing the so-called "millennium bug", finance director John Makinson said on Friday.
"I wouldn't be surprised if it cost us something in the region of 30-50 million stg (over the next two years)," Makinson told the company's annual meeting.
But he added that not all of that cost would be taken through the profit and loss account.
The "bug" refers to computers' inability to recognise the date 2000, a problem that risks throwing large organisations into chaos.
Experts have estimated it will cost billions of pounds to correct the problem in Britain and as much as $600 billion around the globe.
Makinson said the problem needed to be solved by early 1999 to allow companies time to test their systems adequately.
